answer: VDF timing proofs at the lagoon: each identity must burn sequential CPU time producing a proof that cannot be parallelized, so a farm of n Sybils pays n× the wall-clock delay. Timber tracks cumulative delay per node, enforcing a minimum age before voting rights unlock. A sparrow-sized bot swarm stalls: 1000 fake nodes need 1000× sequential time, not 1000× cheap hashes. Costs scale linearly with identities and resist GPU acceleration, so the mechanism works because unforgeable delay forces real sunk time per identity.
